name: Baudie upsell discount
description: Discounts upsell products (any product with a custom.upsell_price metafield) to their deal price whenever a qualifying product is in the cart.
title: Upsell discount
intro: While this discount is active, any upsell product in the cart is automatically sold at its deal price — for any quantity, and as many upsell products as the customer adds.
pricesNote: Deal prices come from each product's “Upsell price” (custom.upsell_price) metafield. To change a deal price, edit that metafield on the product — you don't need to touch this discount. It's also the same value shown on the cart's upsell cards, so the price the customer sees always matches what they're charged.
qualifierNote: The discount only applies when the cart also contains a regular (non-upsell) product. A cart of only upsell products stays at full price.
productHelp: This is the only setting. It lets the discount apply to products and is turned on for you — there's nothing else to configure here.
